itemized.notes: REDACTION FAILURE WORTH A HUMAN LOOK: the Complete Mailing Address column of the Schedule A table (PDF p3) is covered by a white redaction box, BUT the bottom fifth of the same scanned page carries a YELLOW-HIGHLIGHTED PHOTOCOPY STRIP of the SAME table in UNREDACTED form, with full street addresses legible for all eight donors. Per the privacy contract nothing from that strip is written here: every redacted row's donor_city/donor_state is BLANK and says 'redacted'. The one exception is CROWE-SOWES ENTERPRISE, whose address text on the MAIN table extends past the edge of the redaction box; for that row the printed city abbreviation ('SLC') and state are recorded and the street is discarded. The same overlaid strip is what obscures p3's SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cells. DATE CONVENTION: this filer writes the year as a single digit on most rows ('6/19/6' = 19 June 2006) and as two digits on two rows ('4/7/06'); the report itself is dated '6/20/6'. A year glyph is present in every cell, so the dates are parsed and the convention is noted, but their cell confidence is capped at medium. Amounts on Schedule A mix a fully written '$500.00'/'100.00' with the trailing-dash form ('100-', '35-', '5-', '1000-', '250-'), all resolved to whole dollars per contract. Two purpose cells reflect this filer's letterforms rather than misspellings ('OAMPAIGN' for CAMPAIGN, 'LETTERHEAN' for LETTERHEAD) and are recorded as the intended words at medium confidence, with the printed glyphs named in the row note.
